name: Eagle’s Splendor, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5, antipaladin 4, bard 5, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 5, paladin 4, psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

Duration 10 min./2 levels

This spell functions as eagle’s splendor, except it grants an enhancement bonus to Charisma equal to 1/2 your caster level.
